decisive_spans.text: Transesophageal echocardiogram (TEE) confirmed a 6×8 mm non-solid structure on the ventricular aspect of the anterior tricuspid leaflet with a “finger-in-glove” blind-ended protrusion, internally empty with filamentous adherent elements (“garland-like”)

response.rationale: The description of the mass as a 'non-solid structure' with a 'finger-in-glove' blind-ended protrusion and 'filamentous adherent elements' strongly points to Papillary fibroelastoma. While Lambl's excrescences also have filamentous elements, the 'finger-in-glove' appearance is more characteristic of papillary fibroelastoma. The other diagnoses are less supported by the specific morphological description of the mass.
